# Error Handling Rules Template

> **📋 TEMPLATE FOR FUTURE PROJECTS**
>
> This is a reusable template for establishing error handling workflow in new projects.
>
> **How to use**:
> 1. Copy the content below into your new project's `CLAUDE.md` (in the Error Handling section)
> 2. Create an `errorlog.md` file to track errors encountered during development
> 3. Customize the rules based on project needs
>
> **Note**: The `inclusion: always` frontmatter below does NOT work in `docs/` directory.
> For active use, copy these rules into CLAUDE.md's Error Handling section (see AI-DP CLAUDE.md for example).

---

# Error Rules
- access errorlog.md and update
- list every error, attempted solution, and the working fix solution
- review errorlog.md
